Host-native task liveness policy:

Use the canonical proof-or-stop-review-topology-critic role. Do not edit implementation or story files.
Run proof-or-stop acceptance_basis '{"storyId":"B-45a0","json":true}' and inspect topology, scope, exclusions, discovery status, and closure.
A missing, partial, unsupported, stale, or tampered basis cannot receive pass.
Every exclusion must already have a separately attributable proof-or-stop-review-scope-plan approval.
Finish with proof-or-stop topology_critic_receipt_set '{"storyId":"B-45a0","verdict":"pass"}' or verdict=request_changes.
Then run proof-or-stop topology_critic_receipt_check '{"storyId":"B-45a0"}' to verify the persisted signed receipt.

For an OPEN review inventory wave, act as an independent completeness critic only after every required lane has terminal evidence.
Start a fresh critic run with proof-or-stop review_run_start '{"storyId":"B-45a0","agent":"proof-or-stop-review-topology-critic"}', inspect the aggregate finding set and required-lane read coverage, then submit finding_add or review_pass_set with complete read evidence.
Finally bind that terminal evidence with proof-or-stop review_inventory_critic_set '{"storyId":"B-45a0","epochId":"<current epoch>","reviewRunId":"<critic ReviewRun>","agent":"proof-or-stop-review-topology-critic","findingDispositions":[{"findingId":"<verified finding id>","disposition":"verified_family","familyKey":"<independently assessed family>","reason":"<critic evidence>"}]}'. Use findingDispositions:[] only when the aggregate verified finding set is empty; classify every finding exactly once.
